role_in_parent: Extracts the normalized coordinate from x and reconstructs x from it.
statement_nl: Let n be a positive integer and j an integer with 0 <= j <= n - 1. If x is a real number with j/n <= x < (j + 1)/n, and t = n * x - j, then 0 <= t < 1 and x = T_{n,j}(t), where T_{n,j}(t) = (j + t)/n.

domain_restrictions: n is a positive integer (so n is at least 1 and division by n is valid)
j is an integer satisfying 0 <= j <= n - 1
x is a real number satisfying j divided by n <= x < (j + 1) divided by n
t is computed as n times x minus j and is therefore a real number
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For all positive integers n and all integers j with 0 <= j <= n - 1, for every real x with j divided by n <= x < (j + 1) divided by n, if t is defined by t = n times x minus j, then t satisfies 0 <= t < 1 and x equals (j + t) divided by n (equivalently x = T_{n,j}(t) where T_{n,j}(t) is defined as (j + t) divided by n).
quantifier_order: for all integers j such that 0 <= j <= n - 1
for all real numbers x such that j divided by n <= x < (j + 1) divided by n
define t as n times x minus j

variables.name: n
variables.role: index and scaling parameter; divisor and multiplier

variables.name: j
variables.role: interval index for splitting [0,1) into n parts; also used to shift

variables.name: x
variables.role: input point constrained to a specific half-open interval

variables.name: t
variables.role: derived parameter computed from x, constrained to [0,1)

variables.domain: real numbers to real numbers (implicitly used on t)
variables.name: T_{n,j}
variables.role: reconstruction map from t to x for fixed n and j

witness_dependencies: t depends on n and x and j via the definition t = n times x minus j
the identity x = T_{n,j}(t) depends on substituting this t into T_{n,j}(t) = (j + t) divided by n
